#1 position — line layout: head and tail triangles opposed (tail rotated 180° — orientation staged); the cancelling equation itself becomes the polar axis (-1)/(+1) — the scene's own correction carried by its sign; pointer vortex — the round's turning seen.

#2 fork — the mouth · becomes ⑂ and moves to the fork's place (the Eden trade staged as the sign's own transformation); Saturn dims (detention); C24's disc carries an attract field (the mouth that takes every answer); pointer attract/implode — the swallowing.

#3 torus — THE 3D SCENE. z is the torus's through-depth: the torus ring at z 0, the retained opening deep at z −0.38 (the hole you look through, not at), the winding matheme carriers nearest (z +0.3–0.35); (2,−1) becomes [2t,−t] — the displaced lift stated as the path; vortex3d drives the winding; winding LFO on circulation; pointer vortex/vortex; duration 16 — the complete creature held.

#4 variants — ring layout: the comparanda in circulation; the self-rolling wheel ◯↻ turns half a turn (rotation in objectState — continuing formation); pointer vortex gentle.

#5→0 return — the round kept WITH its hole: the intact opening disc holds steady inside the ring (constitutive, not absent); the eightfold carrier bright; ∙ dims to near-still — rest; auto-rest breathes pointer strength. ENDING QUALIFIES BEGINNING: #0's ring wore a costume that hid the opening behind visible completion (the ? at the rim); #5→0 re-forms the same ring with the hole held visible inside it and no filled costume — wholeness keeping its opening; the ? is gone not because it was answered in words but because the structure now carries it (the eightfold −/−→1/0 in the field, C21's efficacy-in-relation, rest without demanded continuation).

Human-amplified staging (binding flags kept): the eightfold recapitulation and the Māyā-not-the-hole distinction yes — carried in the #5→0 body; the paśu correction shared with the Neumann whole; the declared cross-story (torus ↔ uroboros, Māyā-not-the-hole, paśu, self-rolling wheel) in binding relations. glyph_rationales.the uroboros — the body curving around a: The uroboros: the snake bends until its head meets its tail; the body curves around an opening, hunger moving along a relation in which eater and eaten belong to one life.
glyph_rationales.head at tail — the mouth receiving its o: Head at tail: the visible completion — the mouth receiving its own body, the eye brought home through the body.
glyph_rationales.the trickster — circle or sphere as cost: The trickster's costume: head and tail appear to complete a circumference, and that completion offers itself as the whole truth of the creature.
glyph_rationales.what the outline hides — mouth, depth, t: What disappears into the outline: the body's depth, the mouth, the difference of inside and outside, the opening through which self-relation remains possible.
glyph_rationales.the circle seen as an outline — position: Position: seen as an outline the curved body becomes a circle — the determinate image visible while the conditions of seeing it stay concealed.
glyph_rationales.the filled perfection — sphere; the cost: Conceived as filled perfection the round becomes a sphere; the error enters when its completeness answers for the living whole.
glyph_rationales.the signed cancellation — the terminated: (-1)+(+1)=0: the cancelling zero assigned the office of a terminated account — the opposed terms exhausted by the measure that combined them.
glyph_rationales.head — reaches: Opposition restored: the head reaches; hunger gives the orientation urgency.
glyph_rationales.tail — reached: Opposition restored: the tail is reached; the body is simultaneously what seeks nourishment and what enters the seeking mouth.
glyph_rationales.the mouth — the operative opening: The mouth: the operative opening through which the two orientations meet — the formed life coming back through the aperture that permits its transformation.
glyph_rationales.assimilation — what enters changes the l: Assimilation: nourishment enters the creature's powers of movement, response and formation; what has been assimilated becomes a changed capacity to receive.
glyph_rationales.Saturnine detention — the blocked gut; r: The Saturnine refraction: the consuming power takes generation back into itself so nothing issues capable of exceeding its rule — monopoly has a blocked gut.
glyph_rationales.fusion — the mouth that takes every answ: C24 fusion: participation does not authorise assimilating another person; the mouth taking every answer as confirmation has already become the closed account.
glyph_rationales.the Eden-serpent — the hole traded for t: The Eden turn: the opening that kept the relation to its source becomes a deciding fork whose opposed values claim the entire field.
glyph_rationales.the torus — formed surface around an ope: Interposition: the complete creature's winding — mouth, head, tail, surfaces and retained opening belonging to one articulated movement.
glyph_rationales.the opening — Anuttara/Paramaśiva owns i: The appointment: Anuttara/Paramaśiva owns the opening; Māyā is the measure-field wound around it — the opening never becomes one more bounded patch.
glyph_rationales.the winding — four explicate field-lines: The 4+2 winding: four explicate twisting field-lines and two implicates; γ(t)=[2t,−t] returns to its start while the lift retains the difference.
glyph_rationales.the lifted endpoint (2, -1) — the homeco: The lift ending at (2,−1): local closure can retain a difference in the wider relation — the integer pair records the winding class.
glyph_rationales.earthlight — the excluded ground's retur: Earthlight: unconfined discharge — what the completed surface left out becomes an event it must receive.
glyph_rationales.tokamak — the doughnut chamber; magnetic: Tokamak: the field holds charged plasma so its activity can continue within an arranged containment.
glyph_rationales.plasma held so its activity can continue: The held plasma: containment that sustains further passage — holding is not the devouring closure that prevents return.
glyph_rationales.release and holding do different work —: Q27 energetics: release and holding do different work; the distinction concerns what the containing form permits and acknowledges.
glyph_rationales.mother and child — nourishment through d: The Neumann variant: nourishment shown through differentiated dependency, not undifferentiated union.
glyph_rationales.Prajāpati's self-offering — the horse/un: The p.29 encounter: self-creation and self-offering through the horse/universe image — a generative body in the material Frank records.
glyph_rationales.En-Soph; the self-rolling wheel — contin: The p.18 wheel: its winding composes the formed round about an opening it cannot turn into surface.
glyph_rationales.world parents — day and night, four dire: The p.108 note: world parents carrying separation, orientation, opposing valuations and the enduring relation through which differentiation proceeds.
glyph_rationales.Jung's Self/shadow horizon; Gebser's cha: The horizon variants: the Self/shadow pairing and Gebser's changed seeing — different inherited offices, not interchangeable circular emblems.
glyph_rationales.the round — wholeness keeping its openin: The return: the snake comes back with its hole intact — what seemed absence becomes intelligible as constitutive of the form.
glyph_rationales.the intact hole — constitutive, not abse: The retained hole: the whole's wholeness keeps the opening around which it takes form; filling it would change the form whose perfection was claimed.
glyph_rationales.living symbol / idol — the image's effic: C21: the image's efficacy remains in relation to what it cannot exhaust; it becomes an idol when that relation is prohibited from changing it.
glyph_rationales.rest — the completed circuit coming to r: The completion: a completed act can return into another performance or come to rest — perpetual production would restore the consuming hunger.
